columns.name: POSITION_SECURITY_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: VIEW_ALL
columns.description: This option provides unrestricted security access to the specific position security profile.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Denotes name for the Position Security Profile.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: This field represents whether a position security profile is enabled or disabled. When it is enabled, it can be associated with a role.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_AOR
columns.description: This option allows users to restrict person security profiles based on areas of responsibility.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the position security profile.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_POSITION_HIERARCHY
columns.description: This option allows users to restrict positions based on position hierarchy in a position security profile.

columns.name: POS_HIERARCHY_TREE_STRUCT_CODE
columns.description: Code representing the selected position tree structure used in a position hierarchy.

columns.name: POS_HIERARCHY_TREE_CODE
columns.description: When securing by position hierarchy, this is the name of the position tree.

columns.name: TOP_POS_SELECTION
columns.description: When securing position security profile by position tree, this option indicates the top position.

columns.name: POS_HIERARCHY_CONTENT
columns.description: This option indicates position hierarchy content to be used for top position identification.

columns.name: TOP_POSITION_ID
columns.description: A position security profile can be secured by position trees. This option which when enabled, restricts the security up to that position selected as a top position in the tree.

columns.name: INCLUDE_TOP_POSITION
columns.description: This option on the position security profile restricts the security access up to that position selected as a top position in the tree.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_BUSINESS_UNIT
columns.description: This option allows users to restrict positions based on a list of business units from a selected organization security profile.

columns.name: BU_ORG_SECURITY_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: The unique organization security profile used to identify the list of business units secured by the position security profile.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_DEPARTMENT
columns.description: This option allows users to restrict the position security profile based on a set of departments defined by an organization security profile.

columns.name: DEPT_ORG_SECURITY_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: The unique organization security profile used to identify the list of departments secured by the position security profile.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_JOB
columns.description: Attribute not in use - leave blank

columns.name: JOB_SECURITY_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_JOB_SECURITY_PROFILES table.

columns.name: SECURE_BY_LOCATION
columns.description: Attribute not in use - leave blank

columns.name: LOC_SECURITY_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Location security profiles are not in use - leave blank

columns.name: SECURE_BY_POSITION_LIST
columns.description: Secure data based on a list of positions

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: INCLUDE_FUTURE_POSITIONS
columns.description: INCLUDE_FUTURE_POSITIONS

columns.name: SGUID
columns.description: The seed global unique identifier. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
